changelog:
- Initial release: fetch event logs from any EVM contract on any EVM-compatible chain using RPC and ABI.
- Supports automatic ABI discovery from public sources or accepts user-provided ABI.
- Lists available contract events and allows users to choose which to fetch.
- Outputs parsed logs in both text and JSON formats.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, example prompts, and troubleshooting guidance.
summary: Scaffold and fetch event logs from any EVM smart contract via RPC (eth_getLogs + ABI parse). Works on any EVM-compatible chain/contract (Ethereum, L2s, custom chains) given chainId + address + RPC. Trigger when the user asks to get, pull, fetch, sync, or download contract event logs / 合约日志 / 事件日志 /
